description: Fix all Makima AI bugs: localStorage history, Gemini-only-on-SEND enforcement, mobile/desktop UI improvements, cache busting, sidebar drawer behavior, and error handling. This is a single comprehensive bug-fix feature covering items A through I in the user request.
steps: Step 1 - Fix localStorage chat history in static/js/makima-ai.js: (A) Ensure switchChat() properly saves the current active chat before switching. Add createdAt timestamp to each message when pushed. Verify that messages are isolated per chat and never mixed. The existing code looks structurally correct but add defensive checks: reload chats from localStorage fresh in switchChat before rendering, ensure getActiveChat always returns current data.

Step 2 - Add Gemini SEND-only enforcement console.log in static/js/makima-ai.js: (B) Add console.log('[MAKIMA] Gemini request triggered by SEND only') inside the fetch call in sendMakimaMessage(). Confirm no other function calls /api/ai-chat or /api/test-gemini. The code already only calls Gemini on SEND - just add the log line.

Step 3 - Fix mobile UI (max-width 768px) in static/css/makima-ai.css: (C) Ensure sidebar is drawer overlay (already done). Add proper padding-bottom to messages area (at least 110px). Ensure input bar is fixed bottom with left:0, right:0, padding: 10px 12px calc(10px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)), z-index 100 (already 999, keep it). Ensure body/html get width:100%, min-height:100dvh, overflow-x:hidden when makima-ai-body class is active. Ensure the SEND button has width:76px, flex-shrink:0, border-radius:14px and does not get cut off.

Step 4 - Fix desktop/tablet UI in static/css/makima-ai.css: (D) Ensure sidebar is permanent on desktop (already sticky). Ensure chat area input is sticky bottom of chat area (not fixed). Ensure input does not cover sidebar toggle buttons.

Step 5 - Fix Back/Clear buttons hidden behind input in static/css/makima-ai.css: (E) Add padding-bottom of at least 130px to .makima-sidebar-list to ensure footer buttons (CLEAR ALL and KEMBALI KE DOWNLOADER) are not covered by anything. On mobile, ensure the sidebar footer with these buttons is always visible and scrollable above the input area.

Step 6 - Verify custom Clear All modal in static/js/makima-ai.js: (F) The custom modal already exists (_showClearConfirmModal). Verify it calls clearAllChats() which removes makima_ai_chats and makima_ai_active_chat_id, creates new empty chat, and re-renders. The implementation looks correct - no changes needed unless there is a bug.

Step 7 - Update cache busting in templates/index.html: (G) Change all ?v=20260528_2 to ?v=20260528_5 for CSS and JS files. Verify service worker unregister code exists (it does). Verify caches.keys() deletion exists (it does). Remove any <link rel='manifest'> if present (none found). The app.py already sets Cache-Control: no-store headers for HTML.

Step 8 - Verify 429 error handling in static/js/makima-ai.js: (H) The code already checks result.status === 429 and shows 'KUOTA GEMINI SEDANG HABIS. COBA LAGI NANTI.' Ensure it does NOT show 'not configured' for 429. The existing code is correct.

Step 9 - Update responsive.css to ensure Makima AI page is full-width on mobile without conflicting with downloader styles: Remove any conflicting !important rules that might affect the Makima AI layout. The existing rule '.makima-ai-page { width: 100% !important; max-width: 100% !important; padding: 0 !important; }' at end of responsive.css is good.
acceptance_criteria: Messages are correctly isolated per chat - switching chats loads only that chat's messages from localStorage
Console shows '[MAKIMA] Gemini request triggered by SEND only' when user sends a message
On mobile (max-width 768px), sidebar is a drawer overlay, chat area is full width, input bar is fixed at bottom with no cutoff on SEND button
On desktop, sidebar is permanently visible on the left, chat area fills remaining space
CLEAR ALL and KEMBALI KE DOWNLOADER buttons in sidebar are not hidden behind input
All CSS/JS file references in index.html use ?v=20260528_5
Service worker unregister and cache clearing code present in index.html
429 Gemini errors show quota message, not 'not configured'
No calls to /api/test-gemini from any frontend JS file
